description: How long the account keeps documents (retention_days; null: our default), whether each one is deleted right after it's read (delete_after_read), and whether we may use its documents to improve our reading (improve: the person's consent, only when they say so in their own words); the account's name. Owners only; a workflow's own settings are update_workflow_settings. A shorter retention or deleting right after reading also ends page crops for documents read from then on.
name: update_account_settings
title: The account's data settings
